source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 3]
    top, bottom = min(r for r, c in points), max(r for r, c in points)
    left, right = min(c for r, c in points), max(c for r, c in points)
    inside = [(r, c) for r, c in points if top < r < bottom and left < c < right]
    cr, cc = inside[0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(top + 1, bottom):
        for c in range(left + 1, right):
            out[r][c] = 4
    radius = 2
    while True:
        any_cell = False
        for r in range(top + 1, bottom):
            for c in range(left + 1, right):
                dr, dc = abs(r - cr), abs(c - cc)
                if max(dr, dc) == radius:
                    out[r][c] = 2
                    any_cell = True
        if not any_cell and radius > max(bottom-top, right-left):
            break
        radius += 2
    out[cr][cc] = 3
    return out
'''
